descricao: MX5 NAM A2 v7 sobre o firmware oficial HeadRush MX5 2.7

linhas:
# --- NAM mod ---
# Anxiety OD (v1) process() hijack, optionally also Anxiety OD V2's --
# the only NAM path(s) this build applies. One of each hijacked pedal's
# knobs (Drive/Tone/Level) now selects/scans .nam model files.
# (The additive, own-pedal-type design in patch_namloader.py is NOT
# applied here -- see README.md.)
# LD_PRELOAD/NAM_HOOK_SLOT_*_ADDR are scoped to the /usr/Evil/Evil exec
# below via `env`, NOT exported here -- exporting them shell-wide would
# also preload libnam_preload.so into systemd-inhibit (a separate,
# dynamically-linked ELF binary launched right below). Its constructor
# writes to a hardcoded absolute vaddr valid only inside Evil's own
# non-PIE layout; inside systemd-inhibit's unrelated address space that
# write hits unmapped memory and segfaults it before it ever forks Evil
# -- an infinite crash loop, stuck on the splash screen forever.
# --- end NAM mod ---

	### MX5 Bridge: Sicherung zurueckspielen (falls angefordert), Absturzzaehler, Neustart-Marker
	/usr/Evil/Scripts/mx5bridge-db.sh prestart
	mx5bStart=$(date +%s)
	### NAM-Mod (github.com/lolgab/headrush-nam-mod) nur, wenn eingeschaltet
	if /usr/Evil/Scripts/mx5bridge-db.sh nam; then
		systemd-inhibit --what=handle-power-key env LD_PRELOAD=/usr/Evil/libnam_preload.so NAM_HOOK_SLOT_GONK_ADDR=0x31c3804 /usr/Evil/Evil
	else
		systemd-inhibit --what=handle-power-key /usr/Evil/Evil
	fi
	/usr/Evil/Scripts/mx5bridge-db.sh postexit $exitCode $mx5bStart
	if [ -e /tmp/mx5bridge/restart ]; then
		rm -f /tmp/mx5bridge/restart
		sleep 2
		continue
	fi

# NAM: ao remontar o drive (partida e saida da transferencia USB) numera modelos e sincroniza presets
[ -x /usr/Evil/Scripts/nam-sync.sh ] && /usr/Evil/Scripts/nam-sync.sh transfer >>/tmp/nam_sync.log 2>&1 </dev/null

# NAM: numera modelos novos e sincroniza os presets do Anxiety OD (nao critico)
[ -x /usr/Evil/Scripts/nam-sync.sh ] && /usr/Evil/Scripts/nam-sync.sh boot >>/tmp/nam_sync.log 2>&1 </dev/null

# MX5 Bridge: USB-MIDI-Dienst und Datenbankdienst (nicht kritisch)
setsid /usr/Evil/Scripts/mx5bridge-usb.sh daemon >/dev/null 2>&1 </dev/null &
setsid /usr/Evil/Scripts/mx5bridge-db.sh daemon >/dev/null 2>&1 </dev/null &

/usr/Evil/Scripts/mx5bridge-usb.sh evil-begin audio
    ### MX5 Bridge: USB-MIDI-Funktion (nicht kritisch) ###
    { ( mkdir -p functions/midi.mx5bridge &&
        echo 1 >functions/midi.mx5bridge/in_ports &&
        echo 1 >functions/midi.mx5bridge/out_ports &&
        ln -s functions/midi.mx5bridge configs/c.1 ) ||
      logger -t mx5bridge "USB-MIDI-Funktion konnte nicht angelegt werden"; true; } &&
